mapper.sql: tier_official AS ( SELECT rg.grade_slot, rgs.min_win_points::bigint AS min_pts FROM public.rta_rating_grade rg LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs ON rgs.rating_id = rg.rating_id AND rgs.season_id = #{seasonId} WHERE rg.grade_slot IN ('G3', 'G2', 'G1', 'P3', 'P2') )

WITH season_bounds AS ( SELECT (s.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS s0, ((s.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1) AS s1_inc FROM public.rta_season s WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} ), tier_bounds AS ( SELECT sb.s0 AS d0, LEAST(sb.s1_inc, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d1 FROM season_bounds sb WHERE sb.s0 <= LEAST(sb.s1_inc, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) ), day_last AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.wizard_id, t.match_day) t.wizard_id, t.match_day, t.rating_id AS day_end_rating FROM ( SELECT u.wizard_id, (u.played_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS match_day, u.played_at, u.replay_id, u.rating_id FROM public.rta_match_participant u WHERE u.season_id = #{seasonId} AND u.rating_id >= 1000 ) t ORDER BY t.wizard_id, t.match_day, t.played_at DESC, t.replay_id DESC ), wizard_ordered AS ( SELECT wizard_id, match_day, day_end_rating AS cum_max FROM day_last ), wizard_segments AS ( SELECT wizard_id, match_day, cum_max, LEAD(match_day) OVER (PARTITION BY wizard_id ORDER BY match_day) AS next_match_day FROM wizard_ordered ), by_day AS ( SELECT gs.bucket_date, ws.cum_max AS rating_val FROM wizard_segments ws CROSS JOIN tier_bounds tb INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT series.day::date AS bucket_date FROM generate_series( GREATEST(ws.match_day, tb.d0), LEAST(COALESCE(ws.next_match_day - 1, tb.d1), tb.d1), '1 day'::interval ) AS series(day) ) gs ON TRUE WHERE GREATEST(ws.match_day, tb.d0) <= LEAST(COALESCE(ws.next_match_day - 1, tb.d1), tb.d1) ) SELECT bucket_date, grade_slot, COUNT(*)::bigint AS player_count, MIN(sort_order)::int AS sort_order FROM ( SELECT p.bucket_date, ( CASE WHEN p.rating_val >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN p.rating_val >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN p.rating_val >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN p.rating_val >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN p.rating_val >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (p.rating_val % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (p.rating_val % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS grade_slot, ( CASE WHEN p.rating_val >= 5000 THEN 60 WHEN p.rating_val >= 4000 THEN 50 WHEN p.rating_val >= 3500 THEN 40 WHEN p.rating_val >= 3000 THEN 30 WHEN p.rating_val >= 2000 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN (p.rating_val % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (p.rating_val % 10) ELSE 2 END ) AS sort_order FROM by_day p ) x GROUP BY bucket_date, grade_slot

win_agg AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_count FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.ladder_score > 0 AND u.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY u.wizard_id )

wizard_last_match AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id, u.replay_id AS last_rid FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.ladder_score > 0 AND u.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ), latest AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, u.wizard_name, u.country_code AS country, u.channel_uid, u.ladder_score AS score, u.rating_id AS rating_id, r.date_add AS last_match_at FROM wizard_last_match tw INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON u.replay_id = tw.last_rid AND u.wizard_id = tw.wizard_id INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON r.rid = tw.last_rid )

top_wizards AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (wizard_id) wizard_id, wizard_name, country_code AS country, channel_uid, ladder_score AS max_score, rating_id FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND ladder_score > 0 AND wizard_id <> '' ORDER BY wizard_id, ladder_score DESC, replay_id DESC )

pool_500 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, wizard_name, country, channel_uid, max_score, rating_id FROM ( SELECT wizard_id, wizard_name, country, channel_uid, max_score, rating_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY wizard_id ORDER BY max_score DESC, channel_uid::text, wizard_name, country::text ) AS _rn FROM top_wizards ) d WHERE d._rn = 1 ORDER BY max_score DESC, wizard_id ASC LIMIT 500 ), pool_ranked AS ( SELECT wizard_id, wizard_name, country, channel_uid, max_score, rating_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_score DESC, wizard_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM pool_500 )

COALESCE( NULLIF(${alias}.image_url, ''), CASE WHEN ${alias}.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND ${alias}.monster_elemental IS NOT NULL THEN '/images/' || ${alias}.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(${alias}.kr_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || ${alias}.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png' ELSE NULL END )
